articles.title: Sands China Hosts Community Events to Support 73rd Macau Grand Prix
articles.rawDate: Nov.22 Sands China Hosts Community Events to Support 73rd Macau Grand Prix
articles.summary: Sands China was a major sponsor of the 73rd Macau Grand Prix (19–22 November) and, through Sands Cares, invited families from Caritas Macau’s Fonte de Alegria e de Energia centre to a Grand Prix Museum visit, a Street Steel bike-gallery preview, and race day at the Guia Circuit.

articles.title: MGM Wins Gold and Silver at CIHAPB Community Intelligent Housing Award (Greater Bay Area) 2026
articles.summary: MGM COTAI and MGM MACAU won Gold and Silver, respectively, in the Hospitality Category of the CIHAPB Community Intelligent Housing Award (Greater Bay Area) 2026; MGM was the only one of Macau’s six integrated-resort operators to receive an award.

articles.title: Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.rawDate: Nov.17 Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.summary: Sands China unveiled The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory as a permanent attraction on the historic site, developed with Professors Jeffrey Shaw and Sarah Kenderdine and local partners to preserve Macao’s firecracker heritage as a community-tourism landmark.

articles.title: GEG Collaborates with DSAL and Local Organizations to Support the Professional Growth of Local Team Members
articles.summary: Since the start of 2026, around 1,500 local GEG team members have completed over 16,000 training hours with DSAL and local partners. Through the GEG Chef Development Program, GEG became the first Macau integrated-resort operator to run the advanced Chinese cuisine chef occupational skill assessment with DSAL and FAOM.

articles.title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai
articles.summary: On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a kick-off event for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards, themed “Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins.” Wynn announced the 2027 calendar, with judging week in Beijing from August 21–25 and the annual awards ceremony in Macao on October 29.

articles.title: GEG Donates MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong to Support Its Annual Fundraising Campaign for the 23rd Consecutive Year
articles.summary: GEG donated MOP700,000 to Tung Sin Tong’s annual fundraising campaign for the 23rd consecutive year, bringing cumulative donations since 2004 to more than MOP11 million.

articles.title: Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Donates Over MOP 400,000 in Funds and Prizes to Support Caritas Macau Bazaar and Charity Run
articles.summary: Sands China donated funds and gifts valued at over MOP 400,000 to Caritas Macau for the 2026 Charity Run and 57th Charity Bazaar, marking 23 consecutive years of support, with 150 Sands Cares Ambassadors taking part.

articles.title: Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.rawDate: Nov.10 Sands China Performing Arts Programme Presents: ‘Macau Band Directors Association 30th Anniversary Concert’
articles.summary: Sands China partnered with the Macau Band Directors Association to present the association’s 30th anniversary concert at The Parisian Theatre, bringing together more than 550 musicians from Macao and France for audiences of over 1,500.
